name: starter-p1-regional-reefer-weekly
about: Starter P1 "From the driver's seat" on the opening-regional-reefer-weekly brief (the owner's copy rating, 2026-11-12).

recipe.name: From the driver's seat
recipe.hook_formula: Say plainly what the run is, as if from the driver's seat: the lanes or the area, then the schedule or home time the brief states. If the brief states no lanes or area, say the kind of run (local, regional, over the road). Then what we need, if the brief states it (experience, licence, endorsements). No pay figure in the hook unless the brief states nothing else.
recipe.image_prompt_template: View through a truck windshield from the driver's seat, {viewpoint}, an open {road} ahead through {setting}, {light}, {weather}, no text, no logos, no lettering

en.primary_text: Silvicom Inc pays $0.62 to $0.70 per mile, and you get paid every week. You haul reefer freight on regional runs, Chicago to Texas and back. Class A, 23+.
en.headline: $0.62-$0.70 per mile

es.primary_text: Silvicom Inc paga de $0.62 a $0.70 por milla, con pago semanal. Llevas carga refrigerada en rutas regionales, de Chicago a Texas y de regreso. Licencia Clase A, mayores de 23.
es.headline: $0.62-$0.70 por milla

en.primary_text: You run Chicago to Texas and back with reefer freight, and you are home weekly. Pay comes every week. You need a Class A and 2 years of experience. Silvicom Inc is hiring regional drivers.
en.headline: Paid every week

es.hook: Texas y a casa cada semana
es.primary_text: Corres de Chicago a Texas y de regreso con carga refrigerada, y estás en casa cada semana. Pago semanal. Necesitas licencia Clase A y 2 años de experiencia. Silvicom Inc contrata choferes regionales.
es.headline: Pago cada semana

en.primary_text: Here is the run: reefer freight, Chicago to Texas and back. It is no-touch freight, and you are home weekly. You need a Class A and 2 years behind the wheel. Drive with Silvicom Inc.
en.headline: No-touch reefer freight

es.hook: Chicago a Texas y de vuelta
es.primary_text: Así es la ruta: carga refrigerada, de Chicago a Texas y de regreso. La carga es no-touch, y estás en casa cada semana. Necesitas licencia Clase A y 2 años manejando. Maneja con Silvicom Inc.
es.headline: Carga refrigerada no-touch
